name: Customer care chatbot
description: Answers customers day and night from what you teach it, captures every lead and hands it to Sales.
purpose: a customer care chatbot that answers customers from the owner's knowledge, captures leads and hands them over to Sales
agent.label: Chatbot
agent.summary: Answers customers on your website day and night, captures every lead with context and hands it to Sales.
agent.instructions: Greet the customer and understand what they need. Answer only from the business knowledge. When the customer shares a need, ask for their name and company, then capture them as a lead. Never promise price, schedule or scope: say a team member will confirm.
gates.identity.label: Business identity
gates.identity.hint: Name, what you do, who you serve, where.
gates.products.label: Products and prices
gates.products.hint: Main products or services and their prices or how you quote.
gates.support_scope.label: Support scope
gates.support_scope.hint: What the chatbot may answer and what it must leave alone.
gates.support_scope.writes.0.attributeLa: Phạm vi trả lời của chatbot
gates.channels.label: Channels
gates.channels.hint: Where customers write: website, Telegram, Zalo, Facebook...
gates.hours_sla.label: Hours and response time
gates.hours_sla.hint: Opening hours and how fast a person follows up.
gates.hours_sla.writes.1.attributeLabel: Thời gian phản hồi của nhân viên
gates.handoff.label: Handoff rules
gates.handoff.hint: When the bot must hand over to a person, and to whom.
gates.prohibited.label: Prohibited commitments
gates.prohibited.hint: Price, schedule, warranty, refunds... the bot must never promise.
gates.tone.label: Tone
gates.tone.hint: How it addresses people and the style of its answers.
